responses.content: An adult human has 206 bones. Of these, approximately 80 are found in the skull, which includes various bone structures such as the cranium (the outer shell of the head), facial bones, and ear bones. The remaining 126 bones make up the skeletal system outside the skull, including long bones like femur (thigh) or humerus (upper arm), short bones found in wrists or ankles, and flat bones that form the base of various joints such as vertebrae for spinal support.
